entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand Pulse I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, may I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The heart rate monitor is garbage. It's completely inaccurate.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the sensor. Our technical support team is excellent with these kinds of issues. I can transfer you over, and they can walk you through a quick recalibration?
No. I don't have time for that. I just want my money back. I want a refund.
I understand you'd prefer to just return it. No problem at all. Let me just pull up your account to check the return eligibility. Can I have your order number, please?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It was delivered on January 16th, which was 5 days ago. Let me just check the policy.
Alright, yes. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you immediately.
Fine. Whatever. Just send the label.

Of course. I have initiated the return now. You should receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next 10 minutes. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original form of payment.
Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
